on_screen_text: She was furious at him for lying.
voice: This sentence says she was furious. It forgets to make her terrifying.
Stop making angry characters shout. Dangerous fury lowers its voice and organizes the room.

on_screen_text: She refolded his napkin into a sharp triangle, and slid the salt cellar two inches to the left.
voice: Watch the rewrite: She refolded his napkin into a sharp triangle, and slid the salt cellar two inches to the left.

on_screen_text: Now the silence is colder than any slammed door.
voice: Now the silence is colder than any slammed door.

on_screen_text: Loud anger makes noise. Lethal anger organizes the cutlery.
